scope: Float64 root-count topology screen for the secondary -1 critical-curve fold; independent BigFloat/event-curve continuation remains required.

method.description: Independently reimplemented the 8D relative dynamics and variational monodromy, corrected the periodic orbit at each sampled mass pair, and evaluated G-=beta-2 alpha+4 across a narrow m2 slice on opposite sides of the candidate fold in m1. A generic fold should change the local slice from zero roots to two roots.

additional_check.note: The root localization was performed with a looser screening event tolerance than the sign-topology test and is retained only as an approximate branch seed.

conclusion: The local sign topology changes from no sampled -1 zero below the candidate m1 to two sign-change brackets above it, which is strong screening evidence for a -1 event-curve fold creating the secondary lobe. This fold is compatible with, and distinct from, the mixed -1/+1 vertex subsequently found on the secondary lower boundary near m1=0.9967682.
